claims.claim: in south-central New Hampshire only 7 of 42 hatchling observations were autumn emergences, and winter in the nest killed 26–100 % of hatchlings in three winters studied (Carroll & Ultsch 2007)
claims.note: full text not obtained; whether the 7 of 42 and 26–100 % refer to painted turtles alone or to all species in the note cannot be checked

claims.claim: In New Hampshire, all 14 known hatchling emergences fell on 5–24 September (Carroll & Ultsch 2007)
